errors.text: The proposed BCC secondary phase does not reconstruct the compositionally segregated fcc/C14 Laves dual-phase intervention in FeCoNiTi.
The cited evidence shows BCC formation and, principally, changes in saturation magnetization; it does not establish that introducing BCC raises coercivity beyond 100 Oe.
No specific composition, phase fraction, processing window, temperature, field protocol, or quantitative coercivity prediction is provided.
The experiment changes composition and processing simultaneously, so a coercivity change cannot be uniquely attributed to the BCC phase.
